title: Filters
summary: Archive-film treatments shown on the sample clip: a silver print as the base look, sepia, paper and newsprint looks, film wear (grain, scratches, gate weave, flicker, burnt corners), cold light leaks and a crimson wash for emphasis, and splice flashes and dips for cuts. Fourteen are the theme's own (effects/theme_effects.py). Previews run at full strength; use less in a video.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "silver_print", "amount": 0.85}}} and {"name": "splice_flash", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 0.25, "amount": 0.6}. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "old_film", "amount": 0.6, "where": "all"}}. Theme effects: library/themes/historical/effects/theme_effects.py; shared engine: library/_shared/effects_engine.py (OpenCV).

items.name: silver print
items.description: The theme base look: a silver black-and-white print with a cool cast, lifted blacks and firm contrast. Use 0.8–1 on footage.

items.name: sepia tone
items.description: A warm brown albumen-print tone, for older eras or a flashback.

items.name: old film
items.description: Everything at once: half-drained colour, coarse grain, dust, hairline scratches, lamp flicker and dark corners.

items.name: paper print
items.description: The frame becomes a photographic print lying on the dark table: silver-toned, with a mottled paper border and a slight tilt.

items.name: newsprint
items.description: Printed in a newspaper: a coarse ink halftone on yellowed paper.

items.name: film grain
items.description: Coarse silver grain that changes twelve times a second.

items.name: film scratches
items.description: Hairline scratches that wander sideways, dust specks and the odd hair in the gate.

items.name: gate weave
items.description: The picture wanders in the projector gate; now and then the frame line slips into view.

items.name: projector flicker
items.description: Lamp flicker: brightness steps unevenly, with a soft darker band drifting down.

items.name: burnt vignette
items.description: Heavy, uneven dark corners with a warm-black edge.

items.name: blue leak
items.description: A cold steel-blue light leak crossing the frame once over the length of the effect.

items.name: crimson wash
items.description: The theme's one colour takes the frame: a black-to-crimson-to-bone duotone, for a beat of emphasis.

items.name: splice flash
items.description: A film splice: the exposure pops toward white, the picture jumps and the edges burn warm. Put it on a cut.

items.name: dip to dark
items.description: The lamp dims: the picture sinks to near-black from the corners inward. Use "out" before a cut or "in" after one.

items.name: vignette
items.description: Darkens the corners to hold the eye in the middle (shared engine).

items.name: halation
items.description: Bright areas glow red-orange, like light bleeding through film (shared engine).

items.name: film burn
items.description: A warm burn creeping in from the edge of the frame (shared engine).

items.name: letterbox
items.description: Cinema bars close in from top and bottom (shared engine).

items.name: focus
items.description: The lens racks out of focus and back (shared engine).

items.name: camera shake
items.description: A handheld jolt (shared engine).

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to near-black. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
